_comment: Single source of truth for the API-surface derivation shared by two services.
CodeGeneration's ProjectionBuilder builds controllers from it; DocumentService's
ApiContractDeriver builds the API contract document from it. Those are two renderings of one
derivation, and before this existed they were two independent implementations that quietly
disagreed - the document described a DELETE the generator never emitted and omitted the PATCH
Both test suites read this file and assert their own output matches. Changing the derivation
on one side without the other now fails on both. Paths are absolute: the generator's test
joins its module requestMapping to each relative endpoint path before comparing.

declared._comment: The declared endpoint list observed in an approved project's stored PCSF.

crudFallback._comment: What both sides must produce for a module that declares no endpoints of its own.
